findings.finding: Generic derived launcher clears inherited environment and does not forward machine endpoint/model/protocol.
Existing provider health observes worker hello, not model inventory or inference.
Worker already offers inventory-only observation with loaded UNKNOWN and inference NOT_EXECUTED.
Formal UI exposes policy configuration read and per-answer evidence; no inventory probe command yet.

required_behavior: Explicit user-triggered inventory only; no context or inference.
Respect disabled capability before worker admission.
Preserve only declared model launch configuration with bounded process, output and queue timeout.
Project finite validated fields; never expose raw endpoint, exceptions or unbounded model identifiers.
Inventory presence never implies loaded or inference success.
Recheck capability enabled after bounded queue admission as well as before queue.
Failed inventory has unknown count and selected presence (null), never fabricated empty/zero.
Do not directly forward worker probe endpoint, free-text reason or complete inventory.
